about_p1: Tharlam Academy is a sanctuary of learning located in the heart of the Buddhist community in Boudha-6, Kathmandu. We are home to approximately 85 students who receive a comprehensive education that bridges spiritual wisdom with modern academic studies.
about_p2: Our spiritual curriculum is led by our esteemed teachers, Principal Tenpa Gyalsten, Ghen Gyalsten and Ghen Karma, who guide our students in their traditional practices. To ensure a well-rounded education, Tharlam Academy also employs eight dedicated academic teachers, many of whom have supported our mission for over a decade.
about_p3: After operating for many years as a private institution, we have reached a major milestone. We have officially merged with the Manjushree Community School, a local institution that faced challenges following the COVID-19 pandemic. We are proud to announce that our institution is now formally registered and recognized as the Tharlam Manjushree Community School.
about_p4: We invite you to visit us to learn more about our community and our commitment to the next generation of learners.
mission_p1: Our mission is to provide exceptional facilities and a supportive environment for our students. We are dedicated to making them capable, confident, and prepared to navigate and contribute to the world around them.
vision_p1: Our vision is to provide a high-quality education rooted in the spiritual wisdom of the Sakya tradition. We believe in the power of 'Good Deeds and Good Karma,' guiding our students toward a life of purpose and integrity.
values_p1: We are deeply committed to preserving the Sakya tradition that has been passed down from generation to generation. Our values are built on the promise that as long as we are here, our sacred rituals and cultural heritage will continue to flourish.
community_p1: Our community is a warm, welcoming environment built on the foundation of monastic life. For many years, we have served as a home for our students and a place of help and support for all those in need.
principal_title: Principal of Tharlam Manjushree Community School
principal_quote_text: "Supporting a child’s education is like planting the seed of wisdom in this world. We invite you to walk this path with us—gently, generously, and with joy."
buddhist_inspiration_p1: "As a lamp lights another lamp, thousands of lamps can be lit from one. So too, wisdom shared spreads boundless benefit."
testo_subtitle: Hear directly from our students and faculty.
testo1_p1: “Before joining Tharlam Academy, I could not read. Now I can recite prayers, study texts, and help others.”
testo2_p1: "The teachers are kind, and I have many good friends here. We play, we learn, and we help each other like a big family."
testo3_p1: "I came to Tharlam Academy when I was small. Since then, I’ve learned many things — from meditation to math."
testo4_p1: “We’re grateful to all the sponsors who help us learn not only facts but how to be good human beings.”
facilities_subtitle: At Tharlam Academy, we make sure our students have everything they need to feel at home while they learn and grow.
sports_p1: At Tharlam Academy, we believe that staying active is just as important as studying. After each month ends, we hold various sports activities to give our students a chance to exercise and have fun. Since every Saturday and Sunday are holidays, our students use this time to play their favorite games. Most of our young monks are very passionate about football and look forward to playing every weekend. To make things more exciting, we organize special Cup Competitions during important celebrations, such as Lhosar (New Year) or the birthdays of our Gurus. These events bring everyone together in a spirit of teamwork and joy.
